title: Recovery from separating samples
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$, and suppose its algebraic degree is at most $\ell$. Suppose the $m$ sample inputs separate degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient families, meaning that any two such families with the same evaluations at all sample inputs are equal. Then the polynomial represented by the backend solver's output on the samples $(x,f(x))$ equals $f$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: The algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $\ell$
